about.label: 01 — About me
about.p1: I'm Nouhou Ismael Akapo, a junior fullstack developer. I come from a Web Application Development background, and my final degree project was Eduino: a gamified educational platform for children with a parental control dashboard, built together with Yassin Oulad Mohand.
about.p2: I work on both sides. On the front end mostly with React, JavaScript and Tailwind CSS; on the back end with PHP, Node.js and MySQL. Docker is part of my daily workflow — Eduino spins up entirely with a single command, database included.
about.p3: I care about the details: an interface that needs no explaining, code that still reads well months later, and a project that starts up without fighting the configuration. I'm now looking for my first professional role to keep growing within a team.

projects.eduino.desc:
Final degree project. A gamified educational web platform for children: maths, language, English and geography through interactive tests and exercises, with points, achievements, leaderboards and virtual pets, plus a parental control dashboard.

Decoupled architecture: a React front end consuming a PHP REST API on top of MySQL. The whole environment is containerised — the app and the database come up with a single command (docker compose up).
projects.eduino.nota: ▸ You can run it locally with a single command: docker compose up. Full instructions are in the repository README. Test accounts — parent: admin@eduino.com / demo1234 · child: nene / demo1234
projects.bartido.desc: Landing page for a natural smoothie bar in Madrid. Responsive design with scroll animations, 3D tilt cards and direct ordering through WhatsApp. Deployed on GitHub Pages.
projects.bartidobar.desc: Installable version of Bartido as a progressive web app (PWA). It ships a service worker that caches assets and keeps the site working offline, plus a manifest so it can be installed on a phone like a native app.
